SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps_completed
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12
  AND res.laps IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
ORDER BY avg_laps_completed IS NULL ASC, avg_laps_completed DESC
LIMIT 10;
